title: Guru Nanak Jayanti 2026: Date, Gurpurab Rituals and Why the Date Moves Each Year
seoTitle: Guru Nanak Jayanti 2026: Date, Rituals, Why It Moves
seoDescription: Guru Nanak Jayanti 2026 is on Tuesday, 24 November. Why it follows Kartik Purnima, Nanakshahi vs lunar calendar, and the Akhand Path to langar sequence.
excerpt: A year-by-year date table, the lunar maths behind the 19-day jump this year, where the Nanakshahi calendar fits in, and the Prabhat Pheri, Akhand Path and Nagar Kirtan sequence explained.
